note: Formal runs must use the active SIF hash. The GPU-amd64 runtime, once qualified, supersedes this CPU-amd64 lock.

active.build_method: qemu-cross-build (docker buildx --platform=linux/amd64 --load) + docker save/rsync + apptainer build from docker-archive
active.build_command: docker buildx build --platform=linux/amd64 --load -f base-env-build/matclaw-cips/Dockerfile --target matclaw-runtime -t dftworld-base-matclaw-cips:2.2.11-cpu-amd64 . && docker save dftworld-base-matclaw-cips:2.2.11-cpu-amd64 | gzip > /tmp/matclaw-cips-2.2.11-cpu-amd64.tar && rsync -av /tmp/matclaw-cips-2.2.11-cpu-amd64.tar <site-alias>:/public/home/<site-user>/dftworld2-runs/matclaw-031/runtime/ && ssh <site-alias> 'cd /public/home/<site-user>/dftworld2-runs/matclaw-031/runtime && /public/software/apptainer/bin/apptainer build matclaw-cips-2.2.11-cpu-amd64.sif docker-archive:matclaw-cips-2.2.11-cpu-amd64.tar'

superseded.note: arm64 SIF cannot run on the x86_64 cluster (ce_cluster). Kept for provenance; never use for formal runs.
